description: 인천항만공사_인천항 코드 정보 조회 서비스 [ports and harbours] is a dataset listed in Public Data Portal of Korea (data.go.kr), an open data portal, published or maintained by 인천항만공사. 해당 Open API는 인천항의 항만 시설에 대한 코드 정보를 조회할 수 있는 API로, 항코드(prtAtCode), 시설코드(facCode), 시설제원명(facKorNm) 등을 파라미터로. Coverage: 인천항. The portal files it under the publisher 인천항만공사. Its tags are 인천항, 인천항 코드, 항만시설 코드, 시설제원, 접안가능 척수. It offers 1 resource(s) in xml. The portal shows 2026-04-10 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Korean; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support port and shipping studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-kr-dgk-portal.
